title: To Walter Besant?

from-name: Charlotte Mary Yonge
from-address: Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.
to-name: To Walter Besant?
manuscript-location: 'MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95'

[Sir](/person/1652)
I should be very glad of the establishment of the copy right system with [America ](/topic/172)but I should like to have more information before joining the [Company of Authors](/organisation/44).

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The letter evidently relates to the foundation of the Society of Authors in 1884; Besant was the prime mover in the organisation but the letter may have been addressed to a colleague.
